description: Build all settings screens in Jetpack Compose (20+ settings pages). Implement general settings, player settings, subtitle/audio preferences, quality/bandwidth settings, Trakt.tv auth, TMDB config, addon management, theme selector, parental controls, backup/restore UI, profile management. Use Rust SDK for data persistence via storage layer.
